title: 每
teacherNotes: Production A complete-package handoff for L310 每. Use approved sentences exactly. Latest origin/main must be verified before release. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, and Stage 4 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate. Do not use unlearned display characters such as 次, 記, 貓, 暗.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main learned chars through production JSON L306 + provisional learned chars [照, 顧, 忘] + current new char 每
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, labels, logos, brands, subtitles, readable marks, or watermarks anywhere.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 每 as public/assets/lessons/L310/audio/char-u6bcf.m4a from the single character.
For G02 with target at the first Han character, omit prefixSrc and generate only suffixSrc from the exact suffix text.
Generate G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩每天照顧家裡的小狗，可能正在給小狗水或陪小狗坐著。畫面要清楚呈現每天照顧小狗；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩、主角媽媽、主角爸爸都在忙別的事，旁邊的花還沒澆水。畫面要清楚呈現每個人都忘了要澆花；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩只顧著玩玩具，旁邊的花盆或小菜還沒澆水。畫面要清楚呈現只顧著玩、忘了澆水；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
桌上或地上有幾個打開的盒子，每個盒子裡都種了一朵小花，主角小女孩在旁邊看。畫面要清楚呈現每個盒子裡都種了花；盒子不可有文字、數字或標籤。
晚上或室內球場，球場燈光明亮，幾個孩子在球場上活動。畫面要清楚呈現球場照明很好；不可有文字、數字、招牌或標籤。

coverageCheck.allowedCharacterAudit: Production must verify against latest origin/main learned chars + provisionalLearnedChars + current new char before asset work.
